items.title: Reduce manual work with expanded Availability Blocks in Mews Operations
items.summary: Availability Blocks (group blocks in Mews Operations) now support multiple occupancy levels and rates within one space category, accurate pick-up tracking as guest counts change, product rules inherited from the parent rate, adding existing reservation groups to a block without rebuilding it, an updated Availability Block Report, and connected-space relationships in availability calculations.
items.pitch: Group bookings used to mean manual workarounds to keep occupancy, rates, products, and pick-up in sync. Availability Blocks now handle that automatically, so Sales, Reservations, and Revenue teams spend less time reconciling and more time selling.
items.segmentation: Available to all users except Strawberry properties. Tier 3.

items.title: Trial Balance by week, month, or any period in Mews Operations (Batch 1: Americas + Singapore)
items.summary: The Trial Balance moves from daily-only Excel/PDF exports to a live, interactive report in Mews: pick any date range, view summarized ledger data in-app, and export to Excel/CSV/PDF via the Export queue. Coming-soon published 16 Sep; Batch 1 rollout planned week of 28 Sep to US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Puerto Rico and Singapore. Batch 2 (all other legal environments, adds a net/gross revenue toggle) is expected to follow ~2 weeks later — not yet publicly announced.
items.pitch: Finance teams stop stitching daily Trial Balance files together at month-end: one report, any period, straight from Mews.
items.segmentation: Segmented release: US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico first. Other regions: coming-soon expected early October — do not commit to a date.

items.title: Manage languages and services on Central products with more flexibility in Mews Multi-Property
items.summary: Central products now support multiple languages, which propagate automatically to local-level products. Central and local-level products can also be connected via a Central service instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Central products just got more flexible: multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically, and linking products no longer means juggling service keys.

items.title: Scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers in Mews Operations
items.summary: Properties can set up recurring, scheduled exports for the deposit and guest ledgers with custom frequency and automatic delivery, instead of running these exports manually.
items.pitch: Set the schedule once and the ledger data lands automatically, right when finance needs it for reconciliation.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews Operations users. Tier 3.

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Configure how much guests typically spend beyond the room (dining, spa, etc.) as daily or per-stay estimates, with seasonal adjustments. Mews RMS adds that expected spend to the room rate when valuing a booking, so rate recommendations reflect total revenue potential.
items.pitch: Position it as sharper pricing intelligence, not an upsell feature: revenue teams price for what a booking is actually worth to the property, not just the room.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews RMS users. Tier 3.

items.title: Ledger Activity Report focused on meaningful movements
items.summary: The Ledger Activity Report now hides self-balancing movements with no economic value in the selected interval, groups entries by source item, and records a zero-value tax ledger entry for every 0% VAT posting.
items.pitch: Less scrolling through offsetting postings — finance sees what actually happened in the ledger.
items.segmentation: Available to all Mews Operations users.

items.title: Charts added for feature parity between Mews RMS and Atomize
items.summary: Two additional charts were added to the daily view in Mews RMS as part of reaching feature parity with Atomize. Release-note ticket closed 9 Sep; not yet visible on releases.mews.com at time of refresh.

items.title: Mews → Flexkeeping Task Sync
items.summary: Mews tasks sync automatically to Flexkeeping in real time: a task created in Mews appears in the right Flexkeeping user-group queue within 30 seconds, and completion in Flexkeeping updates Mews — no duplicate entry. Live since 1 Sep per the PM; Tier 1 release note moved to localization on 16 Sep.
items.pitch: One task list, two systems: front desk creates in Mews, housekeeping closes in Flexkeeping, both stay in sync.

items.title: Germany B2B e-invoicing (Compliance Suite) — coming soon, GA 1 October
items.summary: Mews will send and receive compliant German e-invoices (Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 / XRechnung) through the Compliance Suite. The coming-soon in-app message to German properties went out 17 Sep (with a German Mews Community post); the PM confirmed in Jira on 23 Sep that GA moves to 1 October 2026. Correction vs. last digest: this was previously listed as GA — it is not live yet.
items.pitch: German properties meet the B2B e-invoicing mandate without changing their workflows or running a parallel invoicing tool.
items.segmentation: Germany only (in-app message targeted at German properties; roles: Property Admin, Finance Manager, Reservations & Revenue Manager, Front Office Manager, GM). Do not communicate as live before 1 Oct.

items.title: Norway B2B e-invoicing — coming soon (mandate 1 Jan 2027)
items.summary: From 1 January 2027 all businesses with Norwegian bookkeeping obligations must issue structured B2B e-invoices. Mews is delivering a Peppol/EHF integration via Marketplace with Invopop (same engine as Belgium and Denmark), targeted for GA end of September 2026; 300+ Norwegian properties affected. A coming-soon in-app notice went to Norwegian customers (ticket closed 17 Sep) pointing to the help article on preparing the organisasjonsnummer.
items.pitch: Norwegian properties get ahead of the 2027 mandate with an integration that already runs for Belgium and Denmark.
items.segmentation: Norway only. GA date not yet publicly confirmed — say 'coming soon', not a date.

items.title: Mews Bank Account — USA pilot (5 customers only)
items.summary: The auto-created release-note ticket for the Mews Bank Account USA pilot was cancelled on 29 Sep: the PM confirmed the pilot ships to only 5 customers, who are being contacted directly. No public release note or coming-soon will be issued at this stage.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Closed pilot, 5 US customers, contacted directly by Fintech.

items.title: Mews Guest Messaging — Early Access now, GA targeted 1 October (hold announcements)
items.summary: Guest Messaging is available to customers who opt into Early Access together with Automations; GA is targeted for 1 October, aligned with Automations and Nova. Explicit instruction from the PM: hold any announcements (PR, LinkedIn, release notes) until 1 October. Customers asking for messaging: share their enterpriseId in #rnd-foh-guestjourney to have it enabled. Expedia channel connection being completed for GA.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Hold all announcements until 1 Oct per #gtm-rnd; Early Access enablement via #rnd-foh-guestjourney only.

items.title: Mews Automations — beta extended, GA targeted 1 October (safety review agent)
items.summary: Automations GA was pushed to 1 October to land safety controls: pre-GA testing showed no adequate safety/correctness check between building and running a flow (manually or via Copilot). Work in progress: a pre-activation AI review agent, better failure-log messaging, guardrails so templates don't apply to every guest, Copilot testing with beta customers. Instruction: hold GA messaging/positioning until 1 October; tell customers asking that testing is being extended.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers. Continue beta with current cohort only; hold GA messaging until 1 Oct per #gtm-rnd.
